eyebrow: Fixing the transpiler seed makes depth testable
code:
def test_bell_transpiles_within_budget():
  qc = build_bell_pair()
  backend = FakeManilaV2()
  t = transpile(qc, backend=backend,
    optimization_level=1,
    seed_transpiler=42)
  assert t.depth() <= 6
  assert t.num_qubits == backend.num_qubits
caption: Without pinning seed_transpiler, randomized layout heuristics make depth vary between otherwise-identical runs.
